# ORO Homes LLC
> Veteran-owned home remodeling contractor serving Columbia, SC and surrounding areas.

## About
ORO Homes LLC is a veteran-owned, licensed residential contractor specializing in kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, and flooring installation. We serve the greater Columbia, South Carolina metro area including Lexington, Irmo, Cayce, West Columbia, and surrounding communities.

## Services
- Kitchen Remodeling: Custom cabinets, countertops, islands, appliance installation
- Bathroom Remodeling: Walk-in showers, custom tile, vanities, accessibility upgrades
- Flooring Installation: Hardwood, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), tile, carpet

## Service Area
Columbia SC, Lexington SC, Irmo SC, Cayce SC, West Columbia SC, Chapin SC, Blythewood SC, Elgin SC, Forest Acres SC, Ballentine SC (25-mile radius of Columbia)
